tei:div.tei:p: dkon mchog spyi 'dus la khas grub chags med ky-i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg sbyor na/ snang mtha' spyan gzigs= gsol 'debs/ skyabs gnas dam pa'i= skyabs sems lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ rang nyid padma 'od 'bar sku ru gyur/ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ rdo rje gsor/ badzra ghandhe hūm̐ dril bu dkrol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga na badzra swa bhā wa atma konyahaṃ/ 'khyud rgya/ rang gi gnas gsum= mchod rlabs/ bdag dang sbyin bdag dbus/ me lha pad 'byung thugs sreg hūm̐= gyur/ sngags/ bdag dang sems can= brgya'am nyer gcig nad gdon= cig a ka ro= mdun gyi= dbus/ me lha pad 'byung= sngags gsham sbyar brgya'am nyer gcig tshe dang bsod= a ka ro= me dkyil dbang= me lha pad 'byung= sngags brgya'am nyer gcig rgyal ba'i= cig a ka ro= me nang drag po'i= me lha pad 'byung= zhing du gyur/ rtsa sngags gsham sbyar bzla ba'am/ dam srid= cig shin tu drag po do gal che na/ bden chung 'gugs pa gsum mam dgu/ me na drag po'i 324) thab khung yongs rdzogs dbus// me lha dmar nag me yi phreng ba can// gtso rkyang 'jigs rung= thim par gyur// artsig= gnod byed dgra bgegs= sbyar ba brgya'am nyer gcig dam sri 'byung po= yang na/ me nang drag po'i thab khung yongs rdzogs dbus// me lha mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can// gtso rkyang= thim par gyur/ aḥkaḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs= brgya'am nyer gcig dam sri 'byung po= mchod 'os phyi nang= tshig bzhi sngags bcas/ rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong= tshig bzhi/ hrī: 'jigs pa brgyad skyob= ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// nyes pa bgyid dang bgyid bstsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /yig brgya/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can= rjes su= sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par= badzra muḥ lha de 'od zhu thugs ka'i sa bon thim// sa bon rang thim dmigs med ngang du gyur// skyabs med mgon med=

bsngo smon dang*/ shes bya'i don la= bkra shis bya'o/ /las bzhi so sor 325) phyes kyang chog pas thog mtha' thams cad dgos/ zhes pa'ang tshe dbang bzhed ngor pad nor ming des bris pa dge legs 'phel// hūm̐: dgang blugs dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i: zhal gyi ngo bo rnam dag cing: rdo rje ljags steng hūm̐ yig gis: sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs nas: zag med bde bas rab tu mnyes: las mthun 'od zer 'phros pa yis: mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur: 326)
